topic: draw out a fresh grease stain from leather
core_question: How do I get a fresh grease or oil stain out of leather before it sets? (secondary: How do I get candle wax out of the carpet?)
answer_summary: Blot any excess oil immediately, then sprinkle cornstarch (or talcum powder) generously over the stain, let it sit for several hours to overnight so it draws out the oil, and brush the powder away.; after the topic shift: Harden the wax with an ice cube, scrape off what you can, then place a paper towel over the spot and press with a warm iron so remaining wax melts into the towel.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang
